title: T1584.001 — Compromise Infrastructure - Domains
subtitle: Watch an attacker take over a trusted domain, point it at attacker hosting, phish a target employee, and see what the SOC notices at the same time.
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker takes over a registrar account, changes the nameservers of a trusted domain, hosts a fake login page, phishes an employee, and the SOC detects the change and reverts the DNS. A written step-by-step version follows below.

nodes.label: Sensitive data

steps.title: Watch for weak domains
steps.caption: The attacker studies expiring-domain lists and checks which organizations run weak registrar security. The goal is a trusted name, not a new one.
steps.defender: passive DNS feeds show unusual lookups on brand-like names.
